messages:
morgan: Heads-up — release CI is red. typegen regen diff from sample app onboarding surfaced a casing rename; blocking the SDK publish.

tara: Which pipeline job failed? link: https://ci.internal/reports/9876 

morgan: typegen-regendiff on linux-x64. Failure snippet:
```
--- a/js-sdk/src/generated/api.ts
+++ b/js-sdk/src/generated/api.ts
@@ -120,7 +120,7 @@
-  retryConfig?: RetryOptions;
+  retry_config?: RetryOptions;
```
Property name changed between generations (camelCase -> snake_case). I reproduced locally using openapi-regen v3.2.0; CI currently runs v3.1.x.

sam: That matches a sorting/normalization change introduced in the regen tool. Did someone flip any generator flags?

morgan: I didn't change flags. v3.2.0 has an internal change to canonicalize vendor extensions and normalizes some names, which could produce the snake_case.

jules: Right — v3.2 made field normalization deterministic but also applies snake_case transformation for some schemas. We need a plan: either pin the generator to v3.1 in CI, or accept the diff with a semver/changelog update.

tara: Our release gate fails on unexpected artifact diffs unless semver/changelog updated. Publishing is blocked until this is resolved.

dev-release-bot: release-check:semver FAILED — regen diff detected in artifacts (typegen-regendiff). To proceed, update changelog/semver or revert generator change.

sam: Temporary unblock: pin openapi-regen to 3.1.* in CI matrix and rerun jobs. We'll open an ops ticket to coordinate a deliberate regen + semver bump if we merge v3.2 changes.

jules: Longer term: add an explicit mapping layer in the codegen pipeline to map OpenAPI property names to the SDK surface (preserve camelCase for public interfaces). Also add a lightweight smoke test in sample-app onboarding that asserts the public API shape for auth/retry options.

morgan: I'll push a CI change to pin the regenerator and run a full regen on a branch to list all impacted files. If diffs are only naming, we can do a patch/minor semver with changelog note. If behaviour changed, we revert.

tara: Also add a checklist item: "confirm typegen tool version and property-name parity before publish". This keeps new customer onboarding from hitting these regressions in sample apps.

ci-bot: Re-run triggered by morgan — queued job 9876.

morgan: Running regen on branch now, will paste diff summary when done. Ping me if you want to triage. @sam @jules

sam: I'll audit generated auth tests to ensure no callsite breaks.

jules: I'll draft the changelog blurb if we ship a minor. If we revert the generator, we'll include the reason in the changelog.
